parsed.review_summary: The corrected rationale addresses all four error targets: it correctly characterizes the 'clearly define what verification means' request as concrete and actionable (fixing the evidence_misread), explains that the rubric does not require the comment to supply the definition content itself (fixing rubric_misapplication), notes that the action and its location are already specified so no execution guidance is missing (fixing the factual_error), and describes the actionability without stating or implying a numeric score (fixing the score_mapping_error). It preserves the original identification of the comment as a direct action and does not introduce new claims. No score or gold label is disclosed.
